messages:
Anya: FYI onboarding Kairos v0.3 (int8 smoke). Seeing a cluster of detok regressions on mixed CJK + Arabic inputs — punctuation or letter pieces get separated and a space appears in the middle of Arabic words. Low BLEU on the cjk_ar subset.
Cheng: can you paste a minimal example?
Anya: sure — small reproducer below. golden vs model (int8) detok:```
Input: 中文和العربية在一起测试。今天怎么样？
Golden detok: 中文和阿拉伯语混合测试。今天怎么样？
Kairos-v0.3 int8 detok: 中文和العربي ة在一起测试。今天怎么样？
```
Anya: Notice the space inside the Arabic word (العربية -> العربي ة) and also the CJK punctuation adjacency handled weirdly. FP16 runtime with same tokenizer is fine.
Jihoon: hmm. Might be tokenizer post-normalizer or an index/merge table change that's amplified by quantized kernel alignment. Which quant config did you use?
Anya: `qconfig: q8_0, per-channel symmetric, kernel-set: qlinear-v2` — FP16 decode matches golden. Token id diff around index 12 in the sequence.
Marcel: is this detok issue or tokenization? The split looks like a post-tokenizer normalizer inserting a ZWJ/space when encountering script boundary. What tokenizer hash did you run?
Anya: tokenizer hash 0xabc123. Re-running with 0xabc122 (previous release) returns correct detok. So rollback of tokenizer proto fixes it.
Sara: can we bisect tokenizer commits between 0xabc122..0xabc123 quickly? I can kick off an automated bisect + quant replay. Assign to me.
Anya: thanks — I dumped a failing list into `/evals/kairos/mixedscript/3750001234-repro.txt` and pushed a tiny repro harness: `./evals/run_repro.sh --model kairos:v0.3 --quant int8 --cases mixed_cjk_ar`.
Jihoon: also double-check KV cache offsets in the int8 kernels — mixed-directionality sometimes shifts cache indexing and that can change alignment of token boundaries at decode-time. Worth validating cache-consistency tests.
Marcel: if the bisect shows the tokenizer normalizer introduced the regression, consider a targeted compatibility exception: revert the normalizer only for CJK<->Arabic adjacency rather than full rollback. Cheaper and lower risk.
Sara: I'll run the bisect tonight and attach logs. @deploy-bot can you schedule a nightly run for the full cjk_ar eval with both int8 and fp16?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job `kairos-cjk-arab-bisect` for tonight 03:00 UTC. Job ID: #9876
Anya: adding one more note — eval PR shows BLEU drop concentrated on sent types with embedded numerals and fullwidth punctuation. I'll add those as high-priority tests.
Marcel: good. if bisect points to tokenizer, please capture the exact mapping delta (old_id -> new_id) for the problematic tokens so we can patch the tokenizer table.
Sara: will do. ETA for bisect run and initial results: tomorrow morning 10:00 UTC.
Jihoon: :thumbsup: thanks team — adding kv-cache and kernel-owner (marcel) to follow up if bisect narrows to runtime.
Anya: thanks all — attaching logs to the ticket and will follow up with failing case list once bisect completes.
